body.text: #7 evidence update: current origin/main runLoopSupervisor and h2a loop supervise work for an opted-in loop. Isolated CLI repro: create --auto-tick then supervise --max 1 yielded ticked=[lane7-probe], frozen=false. Shared h2a store has 5 nonterminal loops and ZERO with policy.autoTick=true, so supervise has no eligible work. User service status cannot be inspected here (no user systemd bus). No code change is justified: the remaining blocker is an owner/conductor operational decision naming a specific loop to enable and confirming the supervisor host/root. Requested feat/loop-demo-codex branch remains absent local+origin; I used detached origin/main only.
